main_measure.name: mean unusual 168-bar move of grid bars with forecast > 0 (return minus coin's mean 168-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 100 independent cases and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of upper half minus lower half, split at median forecast

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are pooled over all coins, each coin's drift is the mean 168-bar return over its grid bars in all windows, the upper half is forecast strictly above the median (ties go to the lower half), and the year condition is read from the recorded 'trending' regime.
